items.name: Flour, Bag O
items.description: For the finest biscuits, cakes and pies.

items.name: Oil, Cooking
items.description: A bottle of cooking oil, made from vegetable extract.

items.name: Bread, Baguette
items.description: Usable as a blunt-weapon 4 days after baking.

items.name: Wack Juce
items.description:
Refreshingly intoxicating, Wack Juce is made with the finest synthetic oranges in Numeria, and the 3rd finest potato vodka in the world: Smashka Noble!
Enjoy this sweet and soothing taste of home, you can almost hear the anthem of the Fatherland as you slurp!

items.name: Butter
items.description: A common cooking fat, adding richness to recipes.

items.name: Ogre Oats
items.description:
A recipe featured in the famous Savage Sustenance Cookbook, Ogre Oats!
A substantial bowl of steel-cut oats cooked with milk, honey, and a variety of toppings such as nuts, dried fruits, and a dollop of creamy yogurt. A nutritious and energizing start to the day.
Benefit: Grants Ogre Oats Buff. Consumer is immune to the Fatigued condition for 6 hours.

items.name: Myceloid Mushroom
items.description: A Myceloid mushroom chunk. Chefs should be aware that the Purple Pox disease can still spread from ingesting this item if it is not prepared with care.

items.name: Berzerker's Hash
items.description:
A famous recipe from Savage Sustenance
Causes a Rage effect for 1 minute, and may not take effect until combat up to 1 hour after eating.
A hearty breakfast skillet filled with diced potatoes, onions, bell peppers, and chunks of smoked ham or bacon. Topped with fried eggs and served with a side of freshly baked bread.

items.name: Milk
items.description: From a cow or goat, you hope.

items.name: Cheese
items.description: A delectable dairy product, enjoyed as a standalone snack or used for culinary creations.

items.name: Salt
items.description:
A basic mineral used to enhance the flavor of foods and preserve them.
Salt is a vital mineral commodity. It is most commonly used as a desiccant and as a catalyst.
Alchemical Power Component:
Doses 20 (10 gp); Spells necromancy school
Spells of the necromancy school are cast at +1 caster level for the purpose of effects.

items.name: Steel-Cut Oats
items.description: Whole oat groats that are cut into smaller pieces, resulting in a hearty and nutritious breakfast option when cooked.

items.name: Brow Brew
items.description:
Brow Brew is an oddity of beers, being produced primarily from grapes harvested from the vineyard of the Numerian town of Iadenveigh. The tough grapes are practically inedible, but are fermented with a particular yeast, grain and wood mushrooms to make a distinctive and rough beer considered an 'acquired taste' by visitors to the town.

items.name: Barbarian Banana Bread
items.description: A famous recipe from Savage Sustenance, this Barbarian Banana Bread is highly filling and is enough to sustain most any four medium creatures or one large creature for 24 hours.

items.name: Ground Beef
items.description: Not necessarily beef….

items.name: Bacon
items.description: Likely hog.

items.name: Desert Coffee
items.description:
This particularly strong coffee is popular throughout the desert empires. A morning cup is a good cure for lack of rest, but many find that it becomes a habit.
Type ingested; Addiction minor, Fortitude DC 12
8 hours; user ignores the effects of the fatigued condition.
After 8 hours; the user becomes exhausted, which is reduced to fatigued only after at least 8 hours of rest (instead of 1 hour).
1 Wis damage

items.name: Bloody Mantis
items.description:
A famous recipe from Savage Sustenance, the Bloody Mantis grants Regeneration buff of Fast-Healing-5 for 5 rounds. Effect delays up to 1 hour or until damage is taken.
A robust and spicy brunch cocktail made with vodka, tomato juice, Worcestershire sauce, and a mix of bold seasonings. Garnished with a celery stalk, crispy bacon, and a pickled vegetable skewer.

items.name: Abby's Own, Royal Vodka
items.description:
Bottled in the historic docks district of Egorian, this fine spirit is rumored to be a favorite of Queen Abrogail II, ruler of Cheliax!
Enhance yourself, enhance your life, with Abby's Own!

items.name: Ham, Pork Leg
items.description: Usable as a melee weapon.

items.name: Sugar
items.description: A prized sweetener used in desserts and various dishes, often imported from exotic lands. Borrowable.

items.name: Egg
items.description: Likely chicken or other domestic fowl.

items.name: Cinnamon
items.description: An exotic and highly prized spice with a sweet and warm flavor, often used in desserts and beverages.
